# Contradiction

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Contradiction`](gmeow-Contradiction.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Contradiction>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A reified conflict between two or more claim nodes — surfaced, attributed ([`gmeow:detectedBy`](../properties/gmeow-detectedBy.md)), kind-classified ([`gmeow:contradictionKind`](../properties/gmeow-contradictionKind.md)), and NEVER resolved by rank. Conflicting claims coexist [`accordingTo`](../properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md) their standpoints (P9); a standpoint may mark one refuted via the EXISTING [`gmeow:claimModality`](../properties/gmeow-claimModality.md), but no winner machinery exists anywhere in the graph. Detection is itself contestable: two detectors disagreeing are two [`Contradiction`](gmeow-Contradiction.md) individuals.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Contradiction`](gmeow-Contradiction.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to SURFACE a conflict between two or more claim nodes as a first-class, attributed, kind-classified relator — making disagreement queryable without choosing a winner (P9).

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it to resolve or rank the conflict (no winner machinery exists — conflicting claims coexist [`accordingTo`](../properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md) their standpoints, and a standpoint marks one refuted via [`gmeow:claimModality`](../properties/gmeow-claimModality.md)) and avoid treating detection as settled; rival detectors are separate [`Contradiction`](gmeow-Contradiction.md) individuals.

### How to use

- Mint a [`gmeow:Contradiction`](gmeow-Contradiction.md), bind at least two claim nodes with [`gmeow:contradictsClaim`](../properties/gmeow-contradictsClaim.md), attribute it with [`gmeow:detectedBy`](../properties/gmeow-detectedBy.md), classify it with [`gmeow:contradictionKind`](../properties/gmeow-contradictionKind.md); leave resolution to standpoint-level [`gmeow:claimModality`](../properties/gmeow-claimModality.md) rather than deletion (P10).

### Examples

- ex:conflict1 a [`gmeow:Contradiction`](gmeow-Contradiction.md); [`gmeow:contradictsClaim`](../properties/gmeow-contradictsClaim.md) ex:claimA, ex:claimB; [`gmeow:detectedBy`](../properties/gmeow-detectedBy.md) ex:nliJudge; [`gmeow:contradictionKind`](../properties/gmeow-contradictionKind.md) [`gmeow:contradictionKindFactual`](../individuals/gmeow-contradictionKindFactual.md).
